name: Rotbloom Pendant
flavour: What blooms on it was never planted.
note: All attributes, life and global defences, plus the Envy aura approximated as a flat increase to chaos damage (no skill, no reservation). The granted Envy skill and its no-reservation line are dropped.

name: Brawler's Fetish
flavour: Empty hands, and nothing to apologise for.
note: Unarmed critical strike chance and critical multiplier. The rule that claw modifiers also apply to unarmed attacks is dropped (no counterpart).

name: Ebbtide Charm
flavour: The sea sends its dead back to you, hungry.
note: Minion life and speed with cold resistance; the added cold damage of minions is approximated as increased minion damage, and the minion mana cost is reduced.

name: Wrathwing Pendant
flavour: Fury, borrowed from something that no longer needs it.
note: Intelligence and life regeneration with strongly increased minion damage. The reference limits the damage to raging spirits and adds a life drain to them; here it applies to all minions and the drain, duration and spirit life lines are dropped.

name: Golemcaller Chain
flavour: Every link remembers being a mountain.
note: Three additional minions at a time, paid for with less minion damage, and much faster minions. The golem-only restriction, size and life lines are dropped: the extra count applies to every summon.
drop: Can Summon up to 3 additional Golems

name: Rimegirt Belt
flavour: Cold seeps outward from the buckle.
note: Strongly increased damage against chilled enemies with cold resistance. The Focus skill lines are dropped.
drop: Chill nearby Enemies when you Focus
Damage with Hits and Ailments against Chilled Enemies
Critical Strike Chance is Lucky while Focussed

name: Hollowgut Sash
flavour: Hunger radiates, and the room goes thin.
note: A burning aura that scorches nearby enemies each second, with longer flask effects, physical and projectile damage and cold resistance. The aura burns for fire damage as a share of maximum life instead of a flat chaos amount; the flask charge penalty is dropped.
drop: Flask Charges gained while using a Flask

name: Snaresmith Cord
flavour: Wire, patience and a very short fuse.
note: Trap damage with stun recovery, mana regeneration and fire resistance. The short trap duration and triggering traps at the end of their duration are dropped (no counterpart).

name: Pallbearer Robe
flavour: The mourners lean on it as they follow.
note: A high energy shield robe whose socketed gems are supported by life leech (the reference limits it to minion gems). Minion blinding and the identified-drops line are dropped.
drop: Socketed Minion Gems are Supported by Level 16 Life Leech

name: Tidewall Plate
flavour: Each wave leaves another layer.
note: Huge armour, life and fire and cold resistance. The crab aspect and its barriers are approximated as a steelskin-style guard triggered when hit; the bleed immunity is dropped.

name: Marshal's Hauberk
flavour: The dead drop their blades; the blades do not stay dropped.
note: Armour, energy shield and life, and each kill has a chance to animate a weapon. The animated-guardian damage and splash lines are dropped, as is the restriction on other minions.
drop: 10% chance to Trigger Level 18 Animate Guardian's Weapon

name: Hexwoven Robe
flavour: Stitched with curses, worn like a coat.
note: Socketed curses are supported by the blasphemy support, and curses can stack beyond the usual limit, on a high energy shield robe. The summoned effigy and its triggered curses are dropped.
drop: Socketed Curse Gems are Supported by Level 20 Blasphemy
Socketed Curse Skills ignore Curse Limit

name: Prowler's Pelt
flavour: Light-footed and never quite seen.
note: Casts the cat aspect (stealth) on hit, with a short cooldown, on a heavy armour and evasion body with big life. The extra stealth duration, the charge gain and the phasing are dropped.
drop: Phasing while you have Cat's Stealth

name: Silkweaver Shroud
flavour: Eight legs, one patient idea.
note: Casts the spider aspect (webs) on hit, with a short cooldown, on a high energy shield robe with intelligence. The web weakening lines, the aspect area bonus and the energy shield regeneration are dropped.
drop: Enemies affected by your Spider's Webs
Aspect of the Spider Area of Effect

name: Mouldering Host
flavour: Plate-mail for a crowd of one.
note: Armour, energy shield and life with the minion meat-shield support. The per-zombie bonuses are flat here, scaled for about four zombies: increased damage and less elemental damage taken.

name: Duskveil Carapace
flavour: Light enters and does not come out.
note: Evasion, energy shield, life and mana. The socketed penetration support is approximated as flat elemental penetration; the shade form trigger and the abyss jewel scaling are dropped.

name: Totemwright Robe
flavour: Carved by hand, worn by ghosts.
note: Socketed spells are supported by the spell totem support, with one additional totem, spell damage and energy shield. Totem life and the curse on totem death are dropped.

name: Feastday Regalia
flavour: Every course is served to the dead.
note: Triggers the bone, flesh and spirit offerings in turn: each fires on hit with its own cooldown, so they come about as often as in the reference but not in sequence. Offerings affecting you are dropped, as is the veiled prefix.

name: Gravecaller Silks
flavour: The silk is thin; the army it commands is not.
note: High energy shield and mana with increased minion damage. The minion life penalty (minions cannot be hurt) and the chaos gain are dropped.
drop: Elemental Damage as Extra Chaos Damage

name: Hunter's Hide
flavour: A steady eye and a fast arrow.
note: Greatly increased critical strike chance for projectile attacks with accuracy, evasion and life. The summoned bestial minion and the bonuses that depend on it are dropped.
drop: while you have a Bestial Minion

name: Ironstride Boots
flavour: Each step is a small act of war.
note: Added chaos damage to attacks, armour, chaos resistance and big movement speed, with strength and a bonus skeleton.

name: Gravetread Slippers
flavour: They never quite touch the ground.
note: Life, mana, energy shield and movement speed with +1 to the level of minion skills (raise zombie and spectre gems in the reference).

name: Deathpledge Plate
flavour: A vow kept by those standing too close.
note: A burning aura that scorches nearby enemies (fire damage as a share of maximum life instead of the chaos aura skill), with attributes, life, attack speed, armour and attack leech. The chaos damage taken on kill is dropped.
drop: Chaos Damage per second for 3 seconds on Kill

name: Featherstorm Raiment
flavour: It was a bird's nest once; do not ask what hatched.
note: Casts the avian aspect (flight and might) on hit, with a short cooldown, on a robe with attributes, lightning resistance, reduced reservation and flat evasion and energy shield. The doubled aspect effect and the party share are dropped.
drop: Aspect of the Avian Buff Effect
Aspect of the Avian also grants
to Evasion Rating and Energy Shield

name: Moonstep Leathers
flavour: Grace, and a cold shoulder.
note: Grants the cold evasion armour skill and dodges spells, with evasion, life, dexterity and a cold resistance penalty. The cold-resistance scaling of evasion is dropped, and phase acrobatics is approximated as spell dodge.
drop: Evasion Rating is increased by Uncapped Cold Resistance

name: Whiteout Leathers
flavour: You can only see it once it has already left.
note: Grants the cold evasion armour skill with spell dodge, evasion, dexterity and life. The stronger buff effect and the cold-resistance scaling of evasion are dropped.
drop: Evasion Rating is increased by Uncapped Cold Resistance
